limitations: Quora pages were not used because automated verification was blocked; no claim depends on Quora.
Reddit was used only for buyer wording and recurring questions, never as technical, legal or operational proof.
Competitor and industry quantity tables were reviewed but not copied; each SKU, package, container and route must be recalculated.
No universal payload, unit count, cost advantage, road allowance or securing method is claimed; the booked equipment, carrier, port and inland route control.
No customer, project, quantity, price, MOQ, lead time, test result, certification or factory-performance claim is made.
Images are conceptual editorial scenes, not evidence of an actual customer shipment, factory event, transport approval or load outcome.
